answer_1.quote: We test GPT-2 and DIALOGPT on different notions of discourse and dialogue coherence by evaluating them on specifically designed test suites building on the SyntaxGym methodology.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate token-level surprisals for text regions, which are used to assess coherence in minimal pairs of sentences.

answer_2.quote: Calculating our CD score allows for a direct evaluation of language models without the need for training a classifier on top of the model representations.
